title: Zero-click preview gate improvement: raise preview success rate from 94% to 95%+ (UX scoring matrix)
deliberation_reason: New track created per UX scoring matrix gap analysis (zero-click preview gate at 94% -> cap 84; target 95%+ -> cap 100). Multiple defensible approaches exist (representative-sheet coverage, print-defect remediation, default-state tuning, gate instrumentation). Must run OSD before committing to a cluster.

phase0.summary: Nominate the zero-click preview cluster(s) to improve. The target is the critical gate, not a criterion per se: raise the representative-sheet zero-click print-ready rate from 94% to >=95% so the gate cap moves from 84 to 100. Candidates from gap analysis: (a) representative-sheet coverage and current defect inventory â€” identify which sheets or sheet-classes are still failing the zero-click test and why, (b) print-defect root-cause remediation â€” fix the recurring blocking defects that require user adjustment (clipping, overlapping, blank/hidden content, pagination, defaults), (c) default-state tuning â€” print styles, pagination, margins, scale, colors, borders, and saved-preference application so the first open is print-safe, (d) print-preview gate instrumentation â€” make the 94%/95% rate itself measurable and reproducible from an evidence artifact, not just a number in a consultation. Run OSD to pick one cluster for Phase 1.

phase1.summary: Improve the nominated zero-click preview cluster. This work is likely to touch js/print_styles.js, print-preview initialization, defaults application from saved preferences, and/or the representative-sheet defect inventory. Must pass: eslint clean, npm run lint, all existing unit tests (no regressions), and existing print E2E where present.

phase2.summary: Likely applicable here: the gate itself is a measured premise. If the track changes the rate, the change must be evidenced, not asserted. Add/update an evidence artifact that reproduces the rate from representative sheets and defect counts.

phase3.summary: Guard-discipline continuity: injected-scope collision, dead-exports, scripts hygiene, full suite, lint, smoke â€” all green. Add regression evidence for the zero-click gate so future sessions can re-run the same rate.

phase4.summary: Checkpoint + frontier review + consultant verification (3 consultants).

phase5.summary: Register, seal, hand-over. Target: zero-click preview success rate >=95% on the next UX scoring run, printing the cap at 100.

context.current_rating_note: This is a critical gate, not a criterion. Its rating does not enter the weighted sum directly; it caps the whole score.
context.current_gate_rate_note: 0.94 is the narrative figure; temp/ux_matrix/evidence_current.json carries 0.886 and disclaims it as an SC-A2 proxy, not a matrix-valid representative-sheet measurement. Phase 1 must replace the proxy with a re-runnable measurement before any code change is credited.
context.gap_analysis: The zero-click preview gate caps the entire UX score at 84 while the rate is in 85-94% range. Pushing the print-ready-without-adjustment rate from 94% to >=95% lifts the cap to 100, which raises the final score to ~88-89 (Strong, bordering Excellent) even without criterion changes. This is the highest-leverage single move in the matrix because the criterion is weighted 25% and the gate caps everything else.
context.fleet_certification: ux_feature_fleet_20261029 completed 18/18 tracks; 2229 unit tests passing
context.handoff_instructions: Fresh session: read this spec + matrix.json + run.py + the existing print E2E/unit tests listed in relevant_files. Read the UX scoring matrix contract first â€” this track is a gate, not a criterion. The acceptance target is a measured rate, not a code change by itself. Run OSD (subspace-deliberation skill) to nominate Phase 1 cluster. Then execute Phase 1 improvement per conductor-protocol. Do not claim 95%+ from a number in prose; re-run the rate from an evidence artifact and score it with run.py.

criteria_note: Draft track: acceptance criteria live in spec.md as [AC-1]..[AC-4] and are NOT sealed. Seal at Phase 5 with `python housekeeping_guard.py seal --track zero_click_preview_improvement_20261103`.
